FAQ

POS frequently asked questions

How much does Odoo POS cost in Egypt?

Odoo Community POS is free; Enterprise requires licensing. Our implementation packages start from a basic single-store setup, and custom modules on the Odoo Apps Store start at €99.

Does Odoo POS work without internet?

Yes. Odoo POS is a Progressive Web App that keeps working when the internet drops, syncing all transactions automatically when the connection returns.

What printers work with Odoo POS?

ESC/POS thermal printers such as Epson TM-T20III and Star TSP143, connected via the Odoo IoT Box or direct network printing.

Can I use Odoo POS for a restaurant?

Yes — floor plans, table management, kitchen display, split bills and tips, with kitchen printing that sends orders straight to the kitchen printer.

How long does POS setup take?

Single store: 3–5 days. Multi-store: 1–2 weeks. With custom modules: 2–4 weeks, including product import, hardware setup, receipt configuration and training.

Do you serve areas outside Aswan?

Yes. Software setup is done remotely; for hardware installation we travel to your location. We serve all of Egypt, with a focus on Upper Egypt.
